v20_arm_ack.description: Arms a checkpoint with a 600 tick timeout. The bundle pauses; the card asks the owner to type /devtool checkpoint ack after a few seconds. Expect CHECKPOINT arm and ack records, an AWAIT with outcome=satisfied carrying latencyTicks, and the end marker.

v20_arm_timeout_control.description: Arms with a 60 tick timeout and nobody acknowledges. Expect AWAIT outcome=timedOut, an ERROR with devtool.wait.timeout, a red chat line, and the bundle halting before its second marker.

v20_cues.description: Three cue forms with distinct labels, one second apart. Expect three CHECKPOINT cue records with cueTick, and the owner to have seen each label on screen: action bar, title, chat, with a sound on the last.

commands.command: devtool checkpoint cue V20_CUE_CHAT chat sound
